definitions.explanation: A year containing 366 days, with an extra day added at the end of February. Occurs roughly every four years.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{閏年|うるうどし}だ。
examples.english: This year is a leap year.

examples.japanese: {閏年|うるうどし}には{二月|にがつ}が{二十九日|にじゅうくにち}まである。
examples.english: In a leap year, February has up to the 29th.

examples.japanese: {閏年|うるうどし}に{生|う}まれた{人|ひと}は、{誕生日|たんじょうび}を{祝|いわ}う{日|ひ}に{迷|まよ}うことがあるそうだ。
examples.english: People born in a leap year sometimes have trouble deciding which day to celebrate their birthday on.

notes:
Composed of {閏|うるう} (intercalary; extra) + {年|とし} (year). The day added in a leap year is {閏日|うるうび} (Feb 29).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閏年|うるうどし}に{当|あ}たる: to fall on a leap year
- {閏日|うるうび}: leap day (Feb 29)
- {閏年|うるうどし}ではない{年|とし}: a non-leap year ({平年|へいねん})

RELATED WORDS:
- {平年|へいねん}: ordinary (non-leap) year
- {閏秒|うるうびょう}: leap second
- {閏月|うるうづき}: intercalary month (in the old lunar calendar)
